reviews.text: Most natrual "glow within" blush i have ever used, the strut red on cool skin tone looks like a natrual flush and is light red that looks like a glow from your natrual cheek color! You can build up for more color but i like to use a sheer layer, my fav blush for no makeup look that looks stunning! Got so many compliments on my skin while wearing it, gonna have to try more colors!
reviews.zh: 用過最自然嘅「由內散發光澤」胭脂，strut red 喺冷調肌上面望落好似自然紅暈，淺淺嘅紅色，望落就好似你本身面珠紅透出嚟嘅光澤！可以層層疊加做出更濃嘅顏色，但我鍾意用通透一層，係我最鍾意嘅裸妝胭脂，望落好靚！用緊期間成日有人讚我塊皮膚好靓，要再試多啲其他色！

reviews.text: Way too sheer and light. I have light skin but even with 3 layers of this blush I’m still not getting enough color payoff. I think you need to be very fair to be able to use this, or pick one of the brighter colors. Texture is amazing though. Wish I could’ve used it
reviews.zh: 太通透太淺色。我已經算白，但就算疊 3 層胭脂都仲係唔夠顯色。我覺得你一定要好白先至用得到，又或者揀返啲鮮色啲嘅色號。不過質地真係好好。遺憾用唔到。

reviews.text:
Gorgeous formula. Super blendable and easy to work with! You can layer it easily if you want to. I like to put it on the back of my hand and pick up the tiniest amount each time and work in layers, it really helps to give that diffused look.

I have neutral fair light skin and this is super flattering on it. Instead of red it looks pretty rosy pink and lovely, almost matching my natural flush. I don't powder it and it lasts for HOURS. I left the house at 13:00 and came home at 23:00 and it was still looking freshly applied. Underrated blush!
reviews.zh:
質地好靚。超級易推開又好用！想疊色都好容易。我鍾意唧少少先喺手背，然後逐次逐次拎最少量去一層層疊，咁樣好有助做出嗰種暈染效果。

我係中性偏白嘅膚色，呢款胭脂上我面超級靚。望落唔似紅色，反而係好靚嘅玫瑰粉，幾乎同我本身嘅自然紅暈一樣。我冇用碎粉定妝，仲撐到好幾個鐘。13:00 出門口，23:00 返到屋企，望落仲好似啱啱塗咁。被低估嘅胭脂！

reviews.text: For me, it’s a bit light, so I have to use more product to make it noticeable, but other than that, it’s a very pretty color and it doesn’t come off easily.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講有少少淺色，所以要搽多啲先睇得出效果，但除咗呢點之外，隻色好靚，而且都幾持久唔易甩。

reviews.text: this is a very sheer product and not very pigmented. i have to use quite a bit which is making me go through the product faster. the color is pretty and the finish is very dewy and non sticky. it just is very sheer and doesn’t last long.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品好通透，唔算好顯色。搽嘅量要比較多，所以用得更快。顏色幾靚，妝效好水潤又唔黏笠。只係好通透，而且唔持久。

reviews.text: I like how light it feels and that the color is light enough for a cute demure blush because I’m blush blind most of the time so this is just dot dot there and blend.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢上臉感覺好輕，顏色淺淺夠晒做出可愛含蓄嘅紅暈，因為我大部份時間都搽唔好胭脂，所以呢款就係點少少喺度再推開就得了。

reviews.text: I ordered this in Strut Red. When I opened it, I thought it was way too bright and opaque. I applied 3 dots on one cheek and spread with my fingers and it sheered out really quickly to provide a very sheer wash of red on my cheeks that looks very natural. I’m really surprised how nicely it blends out and it matches well with my skin tone (a lot of pinks end up looking too pink and weird on me).
reviews.zh: 我訂咗 Strut Red。打開嗰陣以為太鮮色太遮色。喺一面頰點 3 點，再用手指推開，佢好快就化開做一層好通透嘅紅暈喺我面頰上面，望落好自然。佢推開效果咁靚真係好驚喜，而且同我膚色夾得好（好多粉紅色上到我面都會太粉紅望落怪）。

reviews.text: 03 Cool Flutter is a light, lavender-pink shade. The formula is light, hydrating and dewy, so it's not very long-lasting. The colour payoff is weak which is good for very natural bare makeup. It has a translucent finish that enhance clear skin with a subtle dewy flush.
reviews.zh: 03 Cool Flutter 係淺淺嘅薰衣草粉紅色。質地輕、保濕、水潤，所以唔算好持久。顯色度弱，啱晒好自然嘅裸妝。妝效通透，可以襯托透亮膚色加上一抹淡淡嘅水光紅暈。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
